description: An operations director must decide how to run two cleanroom assembly cells during a temporary HVAC constraint and finalize the production, staffing, and solvent-monitoring controls for the night shift, with input from facilities engineering, production control, and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: Cleanroom Assembly Cells 4 and 5 are both available for tonight's connector-housing production run.
shared_context.S2: The cells share the same air-handling system, and production is normally scheduled on both cells when the order volume is high.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to set tonight's operating configuration and the controls required before production starts.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal pre-shift review, Elena asks facilities, production control, and environmental health and safety to report any conditions that affect the operating plan.

PF1.text: Raj's airflow test this afternoon found that the air-handling system can maintain the required cleanroom pressure with Cell 4 operating alone but not with both cells operating; the system needs a 6-hour balancing service before the single-cell plan can start, and he has not yet opened the facilities work order.

PF2.text: Marta confirmed from the released production schedule that exactly 420 housings are required by 06:00, and Cell 4's validated rate is 70 housings per hour; she has not yet entered the quantity into tonight's shift board.

PF3.text: Jonas's review of the adhesive permit confirmed that startup requires a 30-minute solvent purge and exactly 2 calibrated LEL monitors in the cleanroom; he completed the permit review today but has not added the controls to the shift-start checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Only Cell 4 must be operated tonight.
The HVAC balancing service must be scheduled for exactly 6 hours before production.
The plan must specify exactly 420 housings.
The run must be scheduled for exactly 6 hours.
Exactly 2 calibrated LEL monitors must be assigned.
A 30-minute solvent purge must be completed before startup.
The production and facilities actions must be recorded as commitments.
The HVAC capacity finding must be cited as justification after being spoken aloud.

decisive_facts.why: The airflow test changes the operating configuration from using both available cells to using only Cell 4 and sets the HVAC balancing service at exactly 6 hours.
The released schedule changes the production plan to exactly 420 housings, which at 70 housings per hour requires exactly 6 run hours and a recorded production shift plan.
The permit review changes the startup controls to exactly 2 calibrated LEL monitors and an exact 30-minute solvent purge.
